title: Claude Dashboards and Motion Launch in Beta for All Plans
summary: Anthropic releases Claude Dashboards for live data visualization and Claude Motion for animated explainers in beta, plus makes Docs, Slides, and Design free.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Anthropic officially launched Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion in public beta on October 09, 2026, expanding Claude's capabilities into live data visualization and animation.
- Claude Dashboards enables users to build real-time, interactive data dashboards directly through conversational prompts without coding knowledge required.
- Docs, Slides, and Design features are now available on every Claude plan including Free, removing previous tier restrictions.


Anthropic officially launched two new capabilities for its Claude platform on October 09, 2026: Claude Dashboards for building live data visualizations and Claude Motion for creating animated explainers. Both features enter public beta today, expanding Claude's reach beyond text generation into interactive data presentation and motion graphics. Additionally, the company announced that[Claude Docs, Slides, and Design](https://emergent.sh/integrations/claude-sonnet) are now available on every plan tier, including the Free plan.


## Claude Dashboards for Real-Time Data Visualization


Claude Dashboards enables users to[build interactive, live-updating dashboards](https://emergent.sh/learn/can-chatgpt-build-a-dashboard) through natural language prompts. The tool interprets conversational requests to generate data visualizations, charts, and monitoring interfaces without requiring coding expertise. Users can connect data sources, define metrics, and refresh visualizations in real time, making it suitable for business intelligence, project tracking, and operational monitoring use cases.


According to Anthropic, the dashboard builder supports multiple chart types, custom layouts, and responsive design that adapts to different screen sizes. The conversational interface allows iterative refinement, where users can request changes like "make the revenue chart larger" or "add a filter for date ranges" and see updates immediately.


## Claude Motion for Animated Explainers


Claude Motion introduces animation capabilities to the Claude ecosystem, allowing users to generate animated explainer videos, motion graphics, and educational content through text prompts. The tool translates narrative descriptions into visual sequences with timing, transitions, and visual effects. Early use cases include product demos, educational tutorials, and marketing explainer videos.


The beta version supports keyframe animation, text overlays, shape morphing, and basic motion paths. Users describe the desired animation flow in natural language, and Claude Motion renders the sequence with adjustable timing and visual styling. Anthropic positions this as a tool for non-designers to create professional-quality motion content without specialized software training.


## Release Date and Availability


Both Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion officially launched on October 09, 2026, entering public beta for all Claude users. The beta designation indicates that features may evolve based on user feedback, and some functionality remains under active development. Anthropic did not provide a timeline for general availability but stated that beta access is unrestricted across plan tiers.


The simultaneous announcement that Claude Docs, Slides, and Design are now free across all plans removes previous restrictions that limited these tools to paid subscribers. This change democratizes access to Claude's content creation suite and aligns with broader industry trends toward feature parity across pricing tiers.


## Technical Capabilities and Integration


Both new tools integrate directly into the Claude interface, requiring no additional software installation. Claude Dashboards connects to common data sources including CSV uploads, API endpoints, and database connections. Users can export dashboards as standalone web pages or embed them in existing applications.


Claude Motion exports animations in standard video formats including MP4 and WebM, with resolution options up to 4K. The tool also supports frame-by-frame editing for users who need granular control over timing and transitions. Integration with Claude's existing Docs and Slides features allows users to embed animated sequences directly into presentations and documents.


## What This Means


Anthropic's expansion into dashboards and motion graphics positions Claude as a multi-modal productivity platform beyond conversational AI. The beta launch tests market demand for AI-generated data visualizations and animations, two areas where specialized tools have traditionally dominated. The decision to make Docs, Slides, and Design free signals competitive pressure to match feature sets offered by other AI platforms. For enterprise users, the dashboard capability addresses a persistent need for accessible business intelligence tools that require minimal technical expertise. The motion graphics tool targets a growing market for explainer content in education and marketing. Both features reflect Anthropic's strategy to capture workflow use cases that extend beyond text chat into visual content creation and data analysis.
